notes.title: 《Machine Tower》Playtest
notes.notes:
Thank you for your attention to "Machine Tower 2984"! We are about to commence the first internal test of the game.
To ensure the game delivers the best possible experience upon its official release, we sincerely invite you to participate in this internal test and help us refine the game content.

Test Period: March 17, 2025 - March 30, 2025
How to Participate: Sign up via Steam and join the QQ group (195177239) to apply for an internal test code.

Important Notes:

After the internal test concludes, all account data will be deleted. We appreciate your understanding.

If you encounter any issues or bugs during the game, please promptly inform us through the feedback channels. (Leave a message in the QQ group: 195177239).

Thank You for Your Support:
We deeply understand that without your support and feedback, "Machine Tower 2984" would not be able to reach the heights we aspire to. We look forward to your participation and hope that, with your help, "Machine Tower 2984" can become an even more enjoyable game.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us via (QQ group/email). (QQ group: 195177239 / Email: daluosigame@163.com).

Once again, thank you for your support and understanding. We look forward to seeing you during the internal test!
